# dsh-link-compat bundle: one Host row, no client half.
#
# The row publishes ctx.link.compat. The kernel section is chosen from the running
# kernel's own identity, so this row needs no config to work. Set `kernel:` only
# when a shell already knows the identity and wants the loader to agree with it,
# and `strict: false` only to keep a stale refusal from failing the row.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-link-compat
      name: dsh-link-compat
